audience: fundraising teams using Givecloud for supporters and donations

useCases.title: Find a supporter and review consent
useCases.text: Search supporters by name or email, then inspect a matching record and its contact and consent status.

useCases.title: Review contributions for a reporting period
useCases.text: List contributions between UTC date boundaries and inspect an individual contribution’s amount, payment status and selected line items. Continue through result pages for the period.

useCases.title: Review recurring donation schedules
useCases.text: List recurring profiles and inspect their donation amounts, status and next billing dates without exposing payment instruments.

useCases.title: Compare fundraising product goals
useCases.text: Find fundraising products by code or name, then review their prices, fundraising goals and reported progress.
